name: Hino (Shiga, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hino town emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring beneath a winged top, like the character 日.
history: Municipal flag of Hino, a town in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 March 1955.

features.role: Hino town emblem — a stylised device of a ring beneath a winged top, like the character 日
